messages:
maria_sales: FYI AcmeLabs POC is hitting sporadic TTFT spikes during their automated demo run. They're asking for a short-term SLA/committed pool to keep the deal moving. cc @sara_se @ivan_runtime :pray:

sam_cust: attaching a short log slice from today. Observed p95 ~6s, p50 ~0.9s. High KV cache miss ratio reported by client-side telemetry (~78%). 429s seen infrequently.

sam_cust: ```
[2026-03-08T14:02:08Z] req=xyz start=0.007 model=mistral-7b tokens_in=95 tokens_out=32 KV_HIT=false
[2026-03-08T14:02:08Z] latency.p50=0.92s latency.p95=6.12s
[2026-03-08T14:02:08Z] status=200
KV_CACHE_MISS_RATIO=0.78
```

sara_se: quick possible causes: 1) large batching window causing head-of-line blocking on some requests; 2) cache key mismatch (session ids or ephemeral user tokens in prefix); 3) transient rate-limit enforcement on particular nodes.

sara_se: non-invasive mitigations we can roll now: lower max_batch_size 32->10, batch_window_ms 60->20, enable prefix cache keepalive. I can run a 10% canary then promote if green.

ivan_runtime: agree. Also add metrics to surface prefix key cardinality and a histogram of cache key sizes. If the test harness injects per-request salts into the initial system prompt (some frameworks do), hit rate will tank.

ivan_runtime: config snippet (example):
```json
{"serving": {"batch_window_ms":20, "max_batch_size":10, "kv_cache":{"enabled":true, "ttl_seconds":300, "capacity":256}}}
```

maria_sales: customer is asking for price for a 2-week dedicated pool to guarantee latency during their exec demo. Pricing bot, can you give a rough range?

pricing_bot: quick estimate: 2-week reserved pool (3x A10G equiv) with priority routing and 99p latency target -> ~$14k-$20k. If they want 99.9p add ~30%. Can do invoice terms if PO submitted.

maria_sales: thanks. If engineering can stabilize perf for the demo tonight we'll ask them to sign the short PO for the dedicated pool.

nina_security: quick security check: their vendor questionnaire requires EU data residency and minimal prompt retention. For the POC we must redact prompt texts from logs and tag telemetry as ephemeral. We can toggle redaction on the pool. That should satisfy until production.

ivan_runtime: I'll deploy the canary now with batching changes and log-redaction turned on. Doing 10% traffic for 15 minutes then promote.

deploy-bot: deploy started pool=acmelabs-poc change=chg-20260308-01

deploy-bot: deploy finished pool=acmelabs-poc change=chg-20260308-01 :white_check_mark:

sara_se: initial canary metrics: p95 reduced from ~6.1s -> ~2.3s on canary nodes, cache miss on canary ~26%. Across non-canary still high. Monitoring for 20m.

sara_se: note to customer: if your harness creates a unique session prefix per request (e.g., timestamp or nonce in prompt), please switch to session-level prefix or include only user-visible context. That change alone historically moves hit rates from ~20% to ~80%.

maria_sales: Ivan, Nina, Sara: can we get a short written checklist for customer-facing steps (what they must change vs what we changed) so I can send to procurement/legal?

ivan_runtime: I'll write a short checklist: 1) We lowered max_batch_size and batch_window to reduce head-of-line blocking (done). 2) Enabled prefix cache with TTL and increased capacity (done). 3) Enabled log redaction for POC (done). 4) Recommend client change: normalize whitespace + remove ephemeral salts from prefix keys (customer action). 5) Recommend retry budget/backoff on client side to avoid cascade 429s (customer action).

nina_security: I'll confirm that redaction config means no full prompts are written to persistent logs and will post the questionnaire note.

pricing_bot: posted updated quote draft in thread (internal).

sam_cust: re-ran the demo against canary-promoted pool 3: performance looks much better; p95 ~2.2s across their script. We'll confirm for the evening exec run. Thanks team! :tada:

maria_sales: owners/action items: Sara -> monitor and promote; Ivan -> key histograms + checklist; Nina -> security note for procurement; Pricing -> finalize 2-week quote; Sam -> confirm evening demo.

maria_sales: I'll follow up with customer after pricing is sent. Thanks all.
